clamps.notes: TEMPLATE — set count to how many T-track clamps you own, and check the footprint against your actual clamp. Footprint/keep-out are typical values, not measurements of your clamps. Record the clamp's rated hold-down force as hold_down_force_n (from its spec or a measured pull test) — without it the guides cannot prove the hold, only report what the worst cut demands. type is top_down (a bolted hold-down pushes down only; lateral hold is friction, mu x hold-down) unless your clamp is an edge-push or pin type.
TEMPLATE — double-sided tape strips. Set count to how many strips/rolls you keep on hand, or delete this entry if you do not use tape.
TEMPLATE — CA glue + tape / superglue hold-down. Delete this entry if you do not use it.
TEMPLATE — screws through the waste area into the spoilboard. Delete this entry if you do not use it.

TEMPLATE — 6 mm dowel/alignment pins. A pin constrains lateral movement in two dimensions at a point and provides no hold-down; record its rated lateral capacity as lateral_capacity_n when you know it. Delete this entry if you do not use pins for workholding.
